what: Reference sheets for tools/vehicles/fit (br-bwju.5): Muse Image turnarounds (art/ui/frames/generate.mjs --prompt refs/prompts/<sheet>.txt; ledger art/ui/frames/ledger.jsonl). Views are [x0, y0, x1, y1] windows on the 1920x1280 sheets, one view each. A bike's sheets need `segment.bright` (white helmet, silver racks), a small `open` (thin forks) and `keep` (parts joined by a few pixels). `patch` adds ellipses (sheet pixels) for the white helmet the grey backdrop swallows (br-bwju.11). `camD` and `tilt` set the evaluator camera for this sheet: it is a level, far (near-orthographic) render, not the Cruz-calibrated 10 m with an 8 degree look-down (br-bwju.11: front/rear IoU 0.70/0.77 -> 0.84/0.83 on the same model).
